reason: An entity whose attribute ex:v holds `Identifier` http://example.org/target draws DOT text that holds href="http://example.org/target" and no xsd:anyURI. Decision D9 in section 5.7 of `planning/specs/2026-10-20-release-3.3.0-design.md` is the contract. It says prov.dot renders an `xsd:anyURI` `Literal` as its text with a link, as it rendered the `Identifier`, and `_value_cell` does so through `_href_attr`. The value's IRI differs from the IRI of the attribute name, so the href that `_attach_attribute_annotation` writes on the name cell cannot satisfy the assertion. A fault planted in `_value_cell` that keeps the text of an `xsd:anyURI` value and drops its link fails this test, and it is the only test that fails in a whole-suite run.

A bundle whose identifier is under a javascript: namespace draws a cluster that has no URL. The Security entry for prov.dot in the 3.1.1 section of `HISTORY.md` says a link is written only for the schemes http, https, mailto and urn, or none.

A wasGeneratedBy with both endpoints declared draws without any warning, with every warning category turned into an error. The unset-endpoint rule in the 3.2.0 entry of `HISTORY.md` warns only for an unset endpoint, and this test guards against over-warning on a complete relation.

`prov_to_dot` given the direction SIDEWAYS draws a graph whose rank direction is BT, and given LR keeps LR. The docstring of `prov_to_dot`, rendered by `docs/reference/dot.md`, names the valid directions and the BT fallback. Two parametrised rows, `invalid-falls-back` and `valid-kept`, replace the two single-case functions test_dot.py::test_invalid_direction_falls_back_to_bt and test_dot.py::test_valid_direction_is_preserved. The body is the same one build, one call and one equality assertion on get_rankdir, so every input and assertion stays. The verifier planted a fault that passes an invalid direction through and one that forces BT for every direction. The first fails the `invalid-falls-back` row and the second fails the `valid-kept` row, so a failure still names the case.

A namespace written as javascript with a decimal reference, a hex reference, a named reference or a leading space draws no URL or href. The Security entry for prov.dot in the 3.1.1 section of `HISTORY.md` says the scheme is checked on the decoded form of the URI.

An entity label A<b> & "c" draws as A<b> & "c" in the DOT text, never raw, and the graph renders to SVG. The Security entry for prov.dot in the 3.1.1 section of `HISTORY.md` says labels and identifiers are escaped in HTML-like and quoted node labels.

`prov_to_dot` with the direction SIDEWAYS gives a graph whose rank direction is BT. Folded into test_dot.py::test_direction_sets_the_rank_direction_or_falls_back_to_bt as the row `invalid-falls-back`, with the same input, call and assertion. A fault that passes an invalid direction through fails that row, as the verifier planted it. The docstring of `prov_to_dot` states the fallback.

A document with a javascript: namespace keeps http links on ex:safe and its annotation, and gives the js:payload node and the js:alert annotation link no URL or href. The Security entry for prov.dot in the 3.1.1 section of `HISTORY.md` says a link is written only for the schemes http, https, mailto and urn, or none.

`htlm_link_if_uri` given the string "just a string" returned that string unchanged. The helper was removed from prov.dot (#836), and the test went with it. No code under `src/prov` called the helper and no page under `docs/reference/` rendered it, so no test takes over its job.

ProvBundle.plot of a nested bundle to an SVG file warns one DeprecationWarning with the stated message, attributed to the caller, and writes a non-empty file. #652 and `docs/howto/graphics.md` (Draw one bundle) say plot given a bundle that is not a document warns and draws.

A document whose two associations share ex:assoc1 and differ on `prov:plan` raises ProvUnificationError with "an absent prov:plan means none" from ProvDocument.unified, and `prov_to_dot` still draws both associations without a warning. The docstring of `prov_to_dot`, rendered by `docs/reference/dot.md`, says a document that cannot be unified is drawn as given.

A nested bundle, a standalone bundle and a bundle that cannot be unified each draw with one DeprecationWarning, with the stated message, attributed to the caller, and the stated edge count. #652 and the 3.3.0 entry in `HISTORY.md` deprecate drawing a bundle that is not a document, and the docstring of `prov_to_dot` says so.

A namespace URI that holds a double quote draws a URL attribute with the quote escaped by a backslash, and the graph renders to SVG. The Security entry for prov.dot in the 3.1.1 section of `HISTORY.md` says identifiers are escaped in quoted node labels.

With show_element_attributes=False the rendered SVG of an entity with ex:extra set to "value" holds no "value" text. The docstring of `prov_to_dot`, rendered by `docs/reference/dot.md`, says show_element_attributes controls the annotation nodes for element attributes, and `docs/howto/graphics.md` shows turning them off.

An activity start time with a 30-second UTC offset draws as 2026-09-12T10:00:00+00:00 and never as +00:00:30. `docs/reference/values.md` says a datetime offset that is not a whole number of minutes becomes UTC, and row C7 of `docs/reference/conformance.md` states it.

Each canonical example document draws through `prov_to_dot` and renders to an SVG of more than 850 bytes. `docs/reference/dot.md` documents `prov_to_dot`, and `docs/howto/graphics.md` shows a document written out as SVG.

A document whose two generations share ex:gen1 and differ in `prov:time` still draws, with both wasGeneratedBy edges. The docstring of `prov_to_dot`, rendered by `docs/reference/dot.md`, says a document that cannot be unified is drawn as given.

The same unset-endpoint warning for a generation inside a bundle comes once and names the calling test module as its source. The 3.2.0 entry in `HISTORY.md` says the warning is attributed to the caller's own frame even for a relation inside a nested bundle.

A generation with no activity draws one edge to a blank node and warns one ProvWarning that matches Generation and prov:activity. The 3.2.0 entry in `HISTORY.md` says prov.dot warns with ProvWarning when a relation's endpoint is unset and draws it to a blank node.

With use_labels=True an entity labelled "My Entity" draws the label over its identifier, and an unlabelled entity draws its identifier once. #695 and the docstring of `prov_to_dot`, rendered by `docs/reference/dot.md`, say use_labels shows the `prov:label` as the name, and `HISTORY.md` records that an unlabelled element shows its identifier once.

`prov_to_dot` with the direction LR gives a graph whose rank direction is LR. Folded into test_dot.py::test_direction_sets_the_rank_direction_or_falls_back_to_bt as the row `valid-kept`, with the same input, call and assertion. A fault that forces BT for every direction fails that row, as the verifier planted it. The docstring of `prov_to_dot` lists the valid directions.

`htlm_link_if_uri` given the identifier of ex:e1 returned an anchor that held `<a href=` and the IRI http://example.org/e1. The helper was removed from prov.dot (#836), and the test went with it. No code under `src/prov` called the helper and no page under `docs/reference/` rendered it, so no test takes over its job.
